original:
सलोकता समीपता। सरूपता सायुज्यता।
मुक्ती चारी जाण तत्वतां। संतांचिया मते॥
sanskrit:
सलोकता समीपता। सरूपता सायुज्यता।
मुक्ती चारी जाण तत्वतां। संतांचिया मते॥
transliteration:
salokatā samīpatā | sarūpatā sāyujyatā |
muktī cārī jāṇa tatvatā | saṃtāṃciyā mate ||
translation: Residing in the divine realm (Salokya), dwelling near the Divine (Samipya), attaining the divine likeness (Sarupya), and total merger in non-dual unity (Sayujya)—these are the four tiers of liberation recognized by the sages.
meaning: Dashaka 7: Choutha Mukti (The Four Stages of Liberation)

layers.author: samarth-ramdas
layers.content: सलोकता, समीपता, सरूपता आणि सायुज्यता या चार प्रकारच्या मुक्ती आहेत, ज्यांत सायुज्य मुक्ती ही परमोच्च अद्वैत स्थिती आहे.

layers.author: warkari-scholars
layers.content: Gradual liberation unfolds through proximity and harmony until the wave recognizes it has always been the ocean (Sayujya).

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: सलोकता, समीपता, सरूपता और सायुज्यता—संतों के मतानुसार ये मुक्ति की चार अवस्थाएँ हैं, जिनमें सायुज्य मुक्ति सर्वोच्च है।
